name: Generac
description: Generac designs and makes standby and portable generators, home battery storage and energy-management products, and larger generators and mobile equipment for commercial, industrial and data-center customers. Most of the money comes from one-time equipment sales through dealers, distributors, retailers and direct sales, plus a smaller recurring layer from service parts, extended warranties, monitoring and grid-services subscriptions (ecobee, Mobile Link, Blue Pillar). Residential demand is lumpy and tied to power outages, while data-center demand drove international growth in 2025. FY2025 net sales were $4,209M (-2%), net income attributable $159.6M versus $316.3M.

employees.note: Including part-time and temporary employees; about 4,200 directly or indirectly in manufacturing.

businessLines.name: Domestic
businessLines.how: Sells generators, storage and controls to US and Canadian homeowners and businesses through dealers, distributors, retailers and direct channels; one-time hardware sales driven by outages, weather and housing activity.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP segment profit measure)

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Sells the same products plus industrial gensets in Europe, Latin America and elsewhere; 2025 growth came from revenue to data center customers and controls solutions.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP segment profit measure)

businessLines.name: Residential products
businessLines.how: One-time sales of home standby generators, portable generators, storage and energy management devices to homeowners via dealers and retailers.

revenue.period: FY2025 net sales by product class

businessLines.name: Commercial & Industrial products
businessLines.how: One-time sales of stationary and mobile generators and, via multi-unit (MPS) systems, scalable standby power to businesses, telecoms and data centers.

revenue.period: FY2025 net sales by product class

businessLines.name: Other products and services
businessLines.how: Aftermarket service parts and accessories, installation and maintenance, extended warranties plus subscriptions (remote monitoring, grid services paid by utilities through ecobee, software).

revenue.period: FY2025 net sales by product class

brands.name: ecobee
brands.note: Smart thermostats; earns service revenue when utilities pay to connect to enrolled thermostats (grid services).

brands.name: Blue Pillar
brands.note: Acquired 2022; C&I connectivity hardware and software subscriptions.
